snippet.title: The Great Wave | Announcement Trailer | Victoria 3
snippet.description:
The Great Wave is included in Volume 3:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4314630

Wishlist The Great Wave now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4314650

Dominate the waves during a time of upheaval, modernization and political turmoil! Craft hegemonic fleets to extend your grip on the globe through naval actions!

Guide Japan through the last days of the Shogunate, as you forge a modern power ready to challenge the greatest empires of the day. Through sea and steam!

In this new Expansion Pack use the power of your navy in order to dominate local rivals and keep foreign threats at bay! The Great Wave and free Update 1.13 release April 28th.

Read more about The Great Wave and Volume 3 here: https://pdxint.at/4rwoSzg
